papers.title: Multifunctional calcium phosphate based coatings on titanium implants with integrated trace elements.
papers.abstract: For decades, the main focus of titanium implants developed to restore bone functionality was on improved osseointegration. Additional antimicrobial properties have now become desirable, due to the risk that rising antibiotic resistance poses for implant-associated infections. To this end, the trace elements of copper and zinc were integrated into calcium phosphate based coatings by electrochemically assisted deposition. In addition to their antimicrobial activity, zinc is reported to attract bone progenitor cells through chemotaxis and thus increase osteogenic differentiation, and copper to stimulate angiogenesis. Quantities of up to 68.9 ± 0.1 μg cm- 2 of copper and 56.6 ± 0.4 μg cm- 2 of zinc were deposited; co-deposition of both ions did not influence the amount of zinc but slightly increased the amount of copper in the coatings. The release of deposited copper and zinc species was negligible in serum-free simulated body fluid. In protein-containing solutions, a burst release of up to 10 μg ml-1 was observed for copper, while zinc was released continuously for up to 14 days. The presence of zinc was beneficial for adhesion and growth of human mesenchymal stromal cells in a concentration-dependent manner, but cytotoxic effects were already visible for coatings with an intermediate copper content. However, co-deposited zinc could somewhat alleviate the adverse effects of copper. Antimicrobial tests with E. coli revealed a decrease in adherent bacteria on brushite without copper or zinc of 60%, but if the coating contained both ions there was almost no bacterial adhesion after 12 h. Coatings with high zinc content and intermediate copper content had the overall best multifunctional properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛植入物上的多功能涂层，但未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或应力遮挡等AM生物医学材料核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), or as-built surface morphology relevant to AM biomedical materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有抗菌和成骨双重功能的钛植入物涂层。
summary_zh.method: 通过电化学沉积将铜和锌离子掺入磷酸钙涂层。
summary_zh.result: 铜锌共沉积涂层在抗菌和细胞相容性上表现最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞实验和抗菌实验验证涂层功能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop titanium implant coatings that combine antimicrobial and osteogenic properties to address antibiotic resistance and improve osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Copper and zinc trace elements were integrated into calcium phosphate coatings via electrochemically assisted deposition.
summary_en.result: Coatings with co-deposited copper and zinc showed reduced bacterial adhesion and maintained cell viability at optimal concentrations.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture and antimicrobial assays were used to evaluate biocompatibility and antibacterial efficacy.
